title: garden.json
description: The bed manifest every garden tool ships at its repository root, per docs/plans/stem.md §4 and plotplot-ai issue 31 (the coverage block). See contracts/identifiers.md for the season referenced by garden.lock, which this manifest's install targets are pinned against.

name.description: the bed's own name, lowercase always

summary.description: one sentence, optional, for a human reading the manifest directly

kind.description: the roles this bed plays in the garden (as of 2026-09: gate, hook, channel, capability, conductor are in use; the list is open, not a closed enum, because a bed may need a role none of these name). A planted repository that is not a bed declares kind ["repository"]; it then needs only name and kind, and may carry smoke and coverage.

version.description: semantic version of the bed itself, not of this manifest

install.description: how to obtain the bed; at least one of cargo, npm, pip, git or binaries is required, since a bed must be installable by at least one real mechanism. git names a bed distributed today by cloning or vendoring its repository rather than through a package manager.

git.description: a bed distributed by cloning its repository rather than through a package manager; pinned by a full commit sha, never a branch or tag, so the fetch is reproducible

binaries.description: per-platform-triple download URL, keyed by Rust-style target triple

binary_name.description: the executable's file name inside the release artifact; defaults to faces.cli

faces.description: the bed's surfaces: a CLI, a skill, hook entries per harness, git hook entries. At least one face is required.

skill.description: path to the bed's SKILL.md inside the release artifact (the same path it has in the repository), so the stem can copy it into bundles

hooks.description: harness name to the list of hook events this bed registers on that harness

git.description: git hook names this bed installs into core.hooksPath

mcp.description: present only for a bed that is a channel: the tool count, kept low per the zero-tax-presence invariant, and how the stem launches the server in a generated .mcp.json

command.description: the executable, resolved on PATH or relative to the artifact root

args.description: arguments, paths relative to the artifact root

env.description: environment variable names the server reads; the stem writes them into the bundle for the planter to fill

check.description: the command that runs this bed's gate and emits SARIF 2.1.0 on stdout (F2); null for a bed with no gate of its own (kind does not include "gate")

metric.description: the command that measures this bed's one falsifiable metric (F5)

upfront_tokens.description: measured startup context cost (F4): the skill description plus tool schemas a session pays before speaking. null when genuinely unmeasured (invariant 6, "measured or silent": a bed that cannot yet be measured does not get to speak at session start); 0 is a true zero, not an unmeasured gap, for a bed with no skill or MCP face.

coverage.description: plotplot-ai issue 31: which languages and file kinds this bed's judgement actually covers, so silence on an unsupported language is declared rather than read as clean. Either array may be empty for a bed whose rules are language-agnostic (tend2, pollen) or that covers no file kinds at all (a pure conductor).

flagged.description: unknowns this manifest's author could not resolve, named rather than guessed

smoke.description: a planted repository's own entry points that must run (tend 153): each is an argv array, never a shell string, run in the repository root by scripts/smoke.sh and by pleach's smoke gate; weeder never executes them
